title: Who Is This?
description: Ask and answer who a person is in a photo or group.
objectives: Ask and answer who a person is in a photo or group.

stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to ask and answer who a person is in a photo or group. The central language is Who is and demonstrative this. It belongs to the practical context of family & people. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A1, keep the message short and concrete. One clear sentence is enough before the other person responds. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

blocks.english: Who is this in the photo?
blocks.explanation: Use this model to begin the who is this? exchange.
This who is this? model adds a different detail or response.
Use this question or response to keep the who is this? exchange moving.

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “Who is this in the photo?” and “He is my grandfather.” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: Who is and demonstrative this.

items: Communicative goal: Ask and answer who a person is in a photo or group.
Core pattern: Who is and demonstrative this.
Use one clear model, add a relevant detail, and respond to the other speaker.
